    60	        P.require(len(man_by_tag) == P.N_ENDPOINTS, f"manifest has {len(man_by_tag)} != 10 merged hashes")
    61	        P.require(set(man_by_tag) == set(aud_sha) and all(man_by_tag[t] == aud_sha[t] for t in aud_sha),
    62	                  "merged SHA256 mismatch between manifest and merged-audit receipt")
    63	        out["gates"].append("merged_inseparability")
    64	
    65	        # REPAIR-4 (defect 3e): the merged-audit JSON was LOADED and then used only for its ten
    66	        # SHA values. Every census, completeness and migration field it carries -- the evidence
    67	        # the audit exists to produce -- was ignored, so a validator PASS said nothing about
    68	        # whether the endpoints were the declared ones or behaved as declared.
    69	        NONZERO_MIG = P.NONZERO_MIGRATION_BANDS      # repair-5: single-sourced in p4_lib
    70	        ZERO_SEL = P.ZERO_MIGRATION_BANDS
    71	        for b in P.BANDS:
    72	            for ep in P.ENDPOINTS:
    73	                t = f"{b}_{ep}"
    74	                r = aud.get("merged", {}).get(t)
    75	                P.require(r is not None, f"merged-audit has no entry for {t}")
    76	                P.require(r.get("band_meta") == b,
    77	                          f"merged-audit {t} band identity {r.get('band_meta')!r} != {b}")
    78	                idx = r.get("idx_meta")
    79	                P.require(idx is not None and int(float(idx)) == int(ep),
    80	                          f"merged-audit {t} endpoint INDEX {idx!r} != {ep}")
    81	                te = r.get("tree_entries") or {}
    82	                P.require(te and all(int(v) > 0 for v in te.values()),
    83	                          f"merged-audit {t} has an empty tree")
    84	                P.require(int(te.get("mc_signal_reco", -1)) == int(te.get("mc_truth_denom", -2)),
    85	                          f"merged-audit {t} completeness: signal_reco != truth_denom")
    86	                sm = r.get("selection_migration_abs")
    87	                P.require(sm is not None, f"merged-audit {t} has no migration census")
    88	                if b in NONZERO_MIG:
    89	                    P.require(int(sm) > 0, f"merged-audit {t} expected NONZERO migration, got {sm}")
    90	                else:
    91	                    P.require(b in ZERO_SEL, f"merged-audit {t} band {b} in neither migration set")
    92	                    P.require(int(sm) == 0,
    93	                              f"merged-audit {t} is bin-migration-only but migrated {sm}")
    94	        out["gates"].append("merged_audit_census_and_migration")
    95	
    96	        # D4f: bind the component manifest the builder wrote next to this candidate, and prove
    97	        # it describes THIS file. Previously the validator never opened it, so candidate and
    98	        # component provenance were separable -- either could be swapped without detection.
    99	        comp_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(a.candidate)),
   100	                                 "std_component_manifest.json")
   101	        P.require(os.path.exists(comp_path),
   102	                  f"component manifest not found beside the candidate ({comp_path})")
   103	        comp = json.load(open(comp_path))
   104	        P.require(comp.get("candidate_sha256") == out["candidate_sha256"],
   105	                  "component manifest does not describe THIS candidate (sha256 mismatch)")
   106	        # repair-5 (pattern sweep): this used to read `identities.pure_addition` and test it for
   107	        # truthiness -- but the builder wrote that key as a literal `True`, so the check could
   108	        # never fail and proved nothing. The identities are now MEASURED errors, and this
   109	        # consumer RECOMPUTES the full-total identity below rather than reading any of them.
   110	        ids = comp.get("identities", {})
   111	        P.require(isinstance(ids, dict) and ids, "component manifest records no identities")
   112	        P.require("pure_addition" not in ids,
   113	                  "component manifest carries the retired self-asserted `pure_addition` flag; "
   114	                  "it predates repair-5 and its identities were literals, not measurements")
   115	        for _k in ("active_only_eq_sum5_relerr", "C_combined_eq_syst_stat_ml_relerr",
   116	                   "full_total_residual_eq_stat_plus_ml_relerr"):
   117	            P.require(_k in ids, f"component manifest missing measured identity {_k}")
   118	            P.require(float(ids[_k]) <= float(ids.get("identity_rtol", 1e-9)),
   119	                      f"component manifest records a FAILING identity {_k}={ids[_k]}")
   120	        P.require(comp.get("reported_mask_hash") == man.get("mask5d_hash"),
   121	                  "component manifest reported-mask hash != evidence manifest")
   122	        for k in comp.get("candidate_keys", []):
   123	            P.require(_th2(a.candidate, k) is not None,
   124	                      f"component manifest claims key {k} which the candidate does not contain")
   125	        out["component_manifest"] = comp_path
   126	        out["component_manifest_sha256"] = P.sha256_file(comp_path)
   127	        out["gates"].append("component_manifest_bound")
   128	
   129	        active = {b: _th2(a.candidate, f"hCov_active5d_{b}") for b in P.BANDS}
   130	        active = {b: c for b, c in active.items() if c is not None}
   131	        P.require_exact_bands(active); out["gates"].append("exact_5_active_bands")
   132	        out["active_traces"] = P.component_traces_positive_finite(active); out["gates"].append("traces_pos_finite")
   133	        active_total = _th2(a.candidate, "hCov_active5d_total")
   134	        P.require(active_total is not None, "candidate active-only total missing")
   135	        out["active_only_sum_relerr"] = P.check_component_sum(active_total, active)
   136	        out["gates"].append("active_total_eq_sum5")
   137	        for key in (P.CANDIDATE_ACTIVE_TOTAL_KEY, P.CANDIDATE_SYST_KEY, P.CANDIDATE_TOTAL_KEY):
   138	            P.check_symmetric_psd(_th2(a.candidate, key))
   139	        out["gates"].append("symmetric_psd")
   140	        # D4b/D6 REPAIR-5: repair-4 checked only that (C_combined - C_syst) was symmetric PSD
   141	        # and named that the full-total identity, in the gate name, the receipt field and the
   142	        # test. PSD is necessary and nowhere near sufficient -- every covariance-shaped residual
   143	        # passes it. The identity is now PROVEN by loading the stat and ML blocks the component
   144	        # manifest binds (with their recorded sha256 re-verified, so the comparison cannot be
   145	        # satisfied by substituting different blocks) and comparing.
   146	        Csyst = _th2(a.candidate, P.CANDIDATE_SYST_KEY)
   147	        Ccomb = _th2(a.candidate, P.CANDIDATE_TOTAL_KEY)
   148	        stat_spec, ml_spec = comp.get("stat_cov"), comp.get("ml_cov")
   149	        P.require(stat_spec and ml_spec, "component manifest does not bind the stat/ML blocks")
   150	
   151	        def _bound_block(spec, sha_key, label):
   152	            """Load a `path:key` block AFTER re-verifying the sha256 the manifest recorded, so
   153	            the identity cannot be satisfied by substituting a different file."""
   154	            P.require(":" in spec, f"{label} spec {spec!r} is not path:key")
   155	            pth, key = spec.rsplit(":", 1)
   156	            ap = pth if os.path.isabs(pth) else os.path.join(P.ND_ROOT, pth)
   157	            P.require(os.path.exists(ap), f"{label} covariance not found: {pth}")
   158	            P.require(P.sha256_file(ap) == comp.get(sha_key),
   159	                      f"{label} covariance sha256 drift vs the component manifest ({pth})")
   160	            blk = _th2(ap, key)
   161	            P.require(blk is not None, f"{label} covariance key {key} missing in {pth}")
   162	            return blk
   163	
   164	        C_stat = _bound_block(stat_spec, "stat_sha256", "stat")
   165	        C_ml = _bound_block(ml_spec, "ml_sha256", "ML")
   166	        out["full_total_identity_relerr"] = float(
   167	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb, Csyst, C_stat, C_ml, 1e-9))
   168	        out["gates"].append("full_total_identity_recomputed")
   169	        support_bands = {b: _th2(a.support, f"hCov_universe5d_{b}") for b in P.BANDS}
   170	        P.require(all(support_bands[b] is not None for b in P.BANDS), "support family lateral block incomplete")
   171	        out["support_comparison"] = P.check_support_comparison(active_total, sum(support_bands[b] for b in P.BANDS))
   172	        out["gates"].append("complete_support_comparison")
   173	        out["result"] = "PASS"
   174	    except P.P4GateError as e:
   175	        out["error"] = str(e); json.dump(out, open(a.out, "w"), indent=2)
   176	        print(f"RESULT FAIL :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   177	    json.dump(out, open(a.out, "w"), indent=2)
   178	    print("RESULT PASS — gates:", ",".join(out["gates"]),
   179	          f"support_ratio={out['support_comparison']['ratio']:.3f}")
   180	    sys.exit(0)
   181	
   182	
   183	if __name__ == "__main__":
   184	    main()
     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""P4 standard LATER-ONLY adoption CLI — FAIL-CLOSED (repair round 3, 2026-07-18).
     3	
     4	Explicitly consumes the pre-adoption candidate + its inseparable component manifest
     5	and promotes it to an adopted product. Requires: the expected vertical/unified inputs
     6	and their identities (support-family / stat / ML SHA256 == component manifest); the
     7	candidate validator PASS receipt; and rejects aliasing (out path == any input) or any
     8	unvalidated input. NOT run in the repair round and NOT run automatically by the
     9	canonical driver — a deliberate, separately authorized step (needs --i-understand-adoption).
    10	"""
    11	import argparse, json, os, sys
    12	import p4_lib as P
    13	
    14	
    15	def main():
    16	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    17	    ap.add_argument("--candidate", required=True)
    18	    ap.add_argument("--component-manifest", required=True)
    19	    ap.add_argument("--validation", required=True, help="validator JSON (must be PASS)")
    20	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="adopted product path")
    21	    ap.add_argument("--i-understand-adoption", action="store_true")
    22	    a = ap.parse_args()
    23	
    24	    P.require(a.i_understand_adoption, "adoption requires explicit --i-understand-adoption")
    25	    prov = json.load(open(a.component_manifest))
    26	    val = json.load(open(a.validation))
    27	    P.require(val.get("result") == "PASS", "candidate validator did not PASS")
    28	    # identities: the expected vertical/unified inputs are present and hash-matched
    29	    for key, path in (("support_family_sha256", prov["support_family"]),
    30	                      ("stat_sha256", prov["stat_cov"].split(":")[0]),
    31	                      ("ml_sha256", prov["ml_cov"].split(":")[0])):
    32	        P.require(os.path.exists(path), f"expected input missing: {path}")
    33	        P.require(P.sha256_file(path) == prov[key], f"input identity drift: {path}")
    34	    # repair-5 (pattern sweep): this read `identities.pure_addition` and tested it for
    35	    # truthiness, but the builder wrote that key as a literal `True` -- so the strictest gate in
    36	    # the chain was reading a constant and calling it evidence. The builder now records MEASURED
    37	    # errors; this consumer checks them against the declared tolerance instead of a boolean.
    38	    _ids = prov.get("identities", {})
    39	    P.require(isinstance(_ids, dict) and _ids, "component manifest records no identities")
    40	    P.require("pure_addition" not in _ids,
    41	              "component manifest carries the retired self-asserted `pure_addition` flag; it "
    42	              "predates repair-5, when the identities were literals rather than measurements")
    43	    _rtol = float(_ids.get("identity_rtol", 1e-9))
    44	    for _k in ("active_only_eq_sum5_relerr", "C_combined_eq_syst_stat_ml_relerr",
    45	               "full_total_residual_eq_stat_plus_ml_relerr"):
    46	        P.require(_k in _ids, f"component manifest missing measured identity {_k}")
    47	        P.require(float(_ids[_k]) <= _rtol,
    48	                  f"component manifest records a FAILING identity {_k}={_ids[_k]} > {_rtol}")
    49	    # reject aliasing: out must differ from candidate and every input (by realpath)
    50	    reals = {os.path.realpath(p) for p in (a.candidate, prov["support_family"],
    51	                                           prov["stat_cov"].split(":")[0], prov["ml_cov"].split(":")[0])}
    52	    P.require(os.path.realpath(a.out) not in reals, "aliasing: --out coincides with an input/candidate")
    53	    # J32: `P.require(P.sha256_file(...))` tested only that the digest was TRUTHY -- i.e. that the
    54	    # file was readable. It bound nothing. Now that the validator's receipt records which candidate
    55	    # it validated (p4_validate_active_lateral.py), require that this is that candidate.
    56	    cand_sha = P.sha256_file(a.candidate)
    57	    P.require(cand_sha, "candidate unreadable")
    58	    receipt_sha = val.get("candidate_sha256") if isinstance(val, dict) else None
    59	    P.require(receipt_sha is not None,
    60	              "the validation receipt records no candidate_sha256 -- it predates the J32 fix and "
    61	              "cannot bind a candidate; re-run p4_validate_active_lateral.py")
    62	    P.require(receipt_sha == cand_sha,
    63	              f"candidate sha256 {cand_sha} does not match the validated candidate {receipt_sha} "
    64	              "-- this PASS receipt does not certify this file")
    65	    print(f"[adopt] gates PASS; would promote {a.candidate} -> {a.out} "
    66	          f"(not executed here — separate authorized adoption step)")
    67	    sys.exit(0)
    68	
    69	
    70	if __name__ == "__main__":
    71	    try:
    72	        main()
    73	    except P.P4GateError as e:
    74	        print(f"FAIL-CLOSED :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)

    20	def _band_cov(minus, plus):
    21	    """MAT two-endpoint block via uq_math (preserved formula)."""
    22	    from uq_math import mat_covariance
    23	    return mat_covariance(np.stack([np.asarray(minus, float), np.asarray(plus, float)]))

   426	class Repair4DriverContract(unittest.TestCase):
   427	    """REPAIR-4, verifier defect 1. Stages 4-6 had NEVER executed, so nothing caught that the
   428	    driver called the validator and projector with arguments they do not define and a ROOT key
   429	    nothing writes. These tests derive the expectation from the REAL callees -- each script's
   430	    own argparse and the builder's own key constants -- so they fail if either side drifts.
   431	    That is the point: the previous suite asserted only `rc != 0` and was satisfied by an
   432	    argparse error (defect 6b)."""
   433	
   434	    ND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
   435	
   436	    def _driver(self):
   437	        return (self.ND / "run_p4_standard.sh").read_text()
   438	
   439	    def _argparse_opts(self, script):
   440	        """The set of long options a script actually defines, read from its source."""
   441	        import re
   442	        src = (self.ND / script).read_text()
   443	        return set(re.findall(r'add_argument\("(--[a-z0-9-]+)"', src))
   444	
   445	    def _driver_opts_for(self, script):
   446	        """The long options the driver passes to `script`, read from the driver."""
   447	        import re
   448	        drv = self._driver()
   449	        m = re.search(rf"python3 {re.escape(script)}((?:[^\n]*\\\n)*[^\n]*)", drv)
   450	        self.assertIsNotNone(m, f"driver does not invoke {script}")
   451	        return set(re.findall(r"(--[a-z0-9-]+)", m.group(1)))
   452	
   453	    # ---------- D1b/D1c: the driver must speak each callee's real CLI ----------
   454	    def test_driver_passes_only_options_the_validator_defines(self):
   455	        passed = self._driver_opts_for("p4_validate_active_lateral.py")
   456	        defined = self._argparse_opts("p4_validate_active_lateral.py")
   457	        self.assertTrue(passed, "no options parsed from the validator invocation")
   458	        self.assertEqual(passed - defined, set(),
   459	                         f"driver passes options the validator does not define: {passed - defined}")
   460	
   461	    def test_driver_supplies_every_required_validator_option(self):
   462	        passed = self._driver_opts_for("p4_validate_active_lateral.py")
   463	        for req in ("--candidate", "--support", "--manifest", "--merged-audit", "--out"):
   464	            self.assertIn(req, passed, f"driver omits required validator option {req}")
   465	
   466	    def test_driver_passes_only_options_the_projector_defines(self):
   467	        passed = self._driver_opts_for("p4_project_4d.py")
   468	        defined = self._argparse_opts("p4_project_4d.py")
   469	        self.assertEqual(passed - defined, set(),
   470	                         f"driver passes options the projector does not define: {passed - defined}")
   471	        self.assertNotIn("--proj", passed)        # the exact retired argument from defect 1
   472	
   473	    def test_driver_passes_only_options_the_builder_defines(self):
   474	        passed = self._driver_opts_for("p4_build_components.py")
   475	        defined = self._argparse_opts("p4_build_components.py")
   476	        self.assertEqual(passed - defined, set(),
   477	                         f"driver passes options the builder does not define: {passed - defined}")
   478	
   479	    # ---------- D1c: the key must be one the builder actually writes ----------
   480	    DEAD_KEY = "hCov_std" + "_final5_candidate"      # split so this file is not its own hit
   481	
   482	    @staticmethod
   483	    def _code_lines(text):
   484	        """Lines that are not wholly a `#` comment. Keeps history in comments testable-around:
   485	        documenting the dead key is good, *referencing* it is the defect."""
   486	        return [l for l in text.splitlines() if not l.lstrip().startswith("#")]
   487	
   488	    def test_candidate_key_is_produced_by_the_builder(self):
   489	        builder = (self.ND / "p4_build_components.py").read_text()
   490	        self.assertIn("P.CANDIDATE_TOTAL_KEY", builder)      # builder writes the shared constant
   491	        self.assertIn("CANDIDATE_TOTAL_KEY", self._driver()) # driver reads the same one
   492	        self.assertNotIn(self.DEAD_KEY, "\n".join(self._code_lines(self._driver())))
   493	
   494	    def test_dead_candidate_key_appears_in_no_executable_line(self):
   495	        import subprocess
   496	        r = subprocess.run(["git", "grep", "-l", self.DEAD_KEY],
   497	                           cwd=self.ND.parent, capture_output=True, text=True)
   498	        offenders = []
   499	        for rel in r.stdout.splitlines():
   500	            if not rel.strip() or rel.endswith(".md") or "runs/" in rel or "tests/" in rel:
   501	                continue
   502	            body = (self.ND.parent / rel).read_text(errors="replace")
   503	            if self.DEAD_KEY in "\n".join(self._code_lines(body)):
   504	                offenders.append(rel)
   505	        self.assertEqual(offenders, [],
   506	                         f"dead candidate key referenced in executable code: {offenders}")

   515	    # ---------- D1a: stage order ----------

   541	class Repair4EvidenceBindings(unittest.TestCase):
   542	    """REPAIR-4, verifier defect 3 (the two parts that are pure logic and testable ROOT-free)."""
   543	
   544	    ND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
   545	
   546	    def test_config_hash_covers_the_reported_grid(self):
   547	        """D3a: the grid field used to be added to man["config"] AFTER config_hash was

   709	class Repair5SelfGuards(unittest.TestCase):
   710	    """REPAIR-5. One assertion per defect that FAILS if the defect is reintroduced.
   711	
   712	    Every check here is a live computation, not a source-text grep, except where the thing
   713	    being guarded IS a source property. If any of these can be deleted and the four defects
   714	    still stay fixed, the defect was not really closed."""
   715	
   716	    ND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
   717	
   718	    # ---------- D3: dirty-source guard must fail closed on a DELETED source ----------
   719	    def test_deleted_bound_source_is_a_blocker_not_a_pass(self):
   720	        """The old guard read `_w is None or _c == _w`; _worktree_blob returns None when the
   721	        file is gone, so DELETING a bound source passed the dirty check."""
   722	        src = (self.ND / "p4_evidence.py").read_text()
   723	        code = "\n".join(l for l in src.splitlines() if not l.lstrip().startswith("#"))
   724	        self.assertNotIn("_w is None or _c == _w", code)   # the fail-OPEN disjunct is gone
   725	        self.assertIn("need(_c == _w,", code)              # replaced by a direct comparison
   726	        self.assertIn("ABSENT from the working tree", code)
   727	        self.assertIn("os.path.exists(_abs)", code)
   728	        self.assertIn("`git hash-object` failed", code)   # git-unavailable distinguished
   729	
   730	    # ---------- D4a: containment must survive a symlink escape ----------
   731	    def test_symlink_escape_is_rejected(self):
   732	        """A symlink inside the candidate dir pointing out of it must not launder a path.
   733	        normpath could not see this; realpath can."""
   734	        import tempfile, os
   735	        cand_root = os.path.join(P.ND_ROOT, P.CANDIDATE_SUBDIR)
   736	        os.makedirs(cand_root, exist_ok=True)
   737	        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as outside:
   738	            link = os.path.join(cand_root, "_p5_escape_probe")
   739	            if os.path.islink(link) or os.path.exists(link):
   740	                os.remove(link)
   741	            os.symlink(outside, link)
   742	            try:
   743	                with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):
   744	                    P.require_candidate_path(os.path.join(link, "out.root"))
   745	            finally:
   746	                os.remove(link)
   747	
   748	    def test_absolute_path_outside_the_repo_is_rejected(self):
   749	        """The verifier's exact bypass: the component sequence appearing anywhere."""
   750	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):
   751	            P.require_candidate_path("/evil/active_universe_5d/standard/candidate/out.root")
   752	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):

   758	                     "nd-unfolding/active_universe_5d/standard/candidate/std5d.root"):

   760	
   761	    # ---------- D4b: PSD is not the identity ----------
   762	    def test_psd_residual_that_is_not_stat_plus_ml_fails(self):
   763	        """THE self-guard for the overclaim. This residual is symmetric PSD -- so it passes the
   764	        repair-4 check -- but it is NOT stat+ML, so the real identity must reject it."""
   765	        Csyst = np.diag([4.0, 9.0])
   766	        Cstat = np.diag([1.0, 1.0])
   767	        Cml = np.diag([0.5, 0.5])
   768	        Ccomb_good = Csyst + Cstat + Cml
   769	        self.assertLessEqual(
   770	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb_good, Csyst, Cstat, Cml, 1e-9), 1e-9)
   771	        # residual = diag(3,3): symmetric, PSD, and wrong
   772	        Ccomb_bad = Csyst + np.diag([3.0, 3.0])
   773	        P.check_symmetric_psd(Ccomb_bad - Csyst)          # the weak check still passes...
   774	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):              # ...the real identity does not
   775	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb_bad, Csyst, Cstat, Cml, 1e-9)
   776	
   777	    def test_full_total_identity_catches_a_swapped_stat_block(self):
   778	        Csyst = np.diag([4.0, 9.0]); Cstat = np.diag([1.0, 2.0]); Cml = np.diag([0.5, 0.5])
   779	        Ccomb = Csyst + Cstat + Cml
   780	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):
   781	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb, Csyst, np.diag([2.0, 1.0]), Cml, 1e-9)

   793	            P.check_declared_migration_policy(
   794	                "active-universe selection-complete", 0, "BeamAngleX", nz, zs)
   795	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):      # declared bin-only but migrated
   796	            P.check_declared_migration_policy("bin-migration only", 17, "MuonResolution", nz, zs)
   797	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):      # migrates but policy does not claim it
   798	            P.check_declared_migration_policy("weights only", 4792, "BeamAngleX", nz, zs)
   799	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):      # empty policy

   865	class Repair4ReceiptSchema(unittest.TestCase):
   866	    """REPAIR-4, verifier defect 2. The resume path accepted any ROOT plus any nonempty .done.
   867	
   868	    The receipt fixture here is built by running the launcher's OWN `printf` format string,
   869	    extracted from run_p4_unfold_std.sh at test time -- not hand-written to match the reader.
   870	    If the producer's field list changes, this fixture changes with it, and a reader that
   871	    drifted from the writer fails here. That inversion (fixture shaped like the consumer) is
   872	    precisely BEN-040, in this same chain."""
   873	
   874	    ND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
   875	
   876	    GOOD = dict(tag="BeamAngleX_0", root_sha256="a" * 64, merged_sha256="b" * 64,
   877	                central5d_sha256="c" * 64, config_hash="d" * 64, bkg_mode="purity",
   878	                code_rev="e" * 40, unfold_blob="f" * 40)
   879	
   880	    def _producer_receipt(self, mode="produced", **over):
   881	        """Render a receipt through the launcher's real format string."""
   882	        import re, subprocess, json
   883	        sh = (self.ND / "run_p4_unfold_std.sh").read_text()
   884	        m = re.search(r"printf '(\{\"tag\".*?\}\\n)'", sh, re.S)
   885	        self.assertIsNotNone(m, "could not extract the launcher's receipt format")
   886	        fmt = m.group(1)
   887	        vals = dict(self.GOOD); vals.update(over)
   888	        # positional order matches the launcher's own argument order
   889	        args = [vals["tag"], vals["root_sha256"], vals["merged_sha256"], vals["central5d_sha256"],
   890	                vals["config_hash"], vals["bkg_mode"], vals["code_rev"], vals["unfold_blob"],
   891	                "2026-08-07T00:00:00Z"]
   892	        if mode == "legacy-attested":
   893	            fmt = fmt.replace('"mode":"produced"', '"mode":"legacy-attested"')
   894	        out = subprocess.run(["printf", fmt, *args], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
   895	        return json.loads(out)
   896	
   897	    def test_producer_receipt_has_every_required_key(self):
   898	        rec = self._producer_receipt()
   899	        for k in P.RECEIPT_REQUIRED_KEYS:
   900	            self.assertIn(k, rec, f"the real producer omits required key {k}")
   901	
   902	    def test_validator_accepts_the_real_producer_output(self):
   903	        rec = self._producer_receipt()
   904	        self.assertTrue(P.validate_endpoint_receipt(rec, **self.GOOD))
   905	
   906	    def test_legacy_attested_receipt_now_carries_merged_and_central(self):
   907	        """D2b: the legacy receipt used to omit these, making an attested endpoint permanently
   908	        less provable than a produced one."""

     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# STANDARD P4 stage-1: 10 endpoint hadd-merges (CONC-capped for Lustre) + acceptance
     3	# audit. Runs inside a held interactive CPU alloc (via alloc_run srun --overlap; the
     4	# whole node is ours, so bare-background hadds are fine). skip-if-exists.
     5	set -o pipefail
     6	export HOME=/global/homes/j/josephrb
     7	REPO="/pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/MINERvA-OmniFold"; ND="${REPO}/nd-unfolding"
     8	PLAYLISTS=(1A 1B 1C 1D 1E 1F 1G 1L 1M 1N 1O 1P)
     9	BANDS=(BeamAngleX BeamAngleY MuonResolution Muon_Energy_MINERvA Muon_Energy_MINOS)
    10	MERGEDIR="${ND}/active_universe_5d/standard/merged"; mkdir -p "${MERGEDIR}"
    11	CONC="${CONC:-4}"
    12	echo "[p4-merge] start $(date -u +%T) CONC=${CONC}"
    13	valid_merged () {  # a complete merged ROOT opens with the 4 trees
    14	  python3 -c "import ROOT,sys; f=ROOT.TFile.Open('$1'); sys.exit(0 if (f and not f.IsZombie() and f.Get('mc_truth_denom') and f.Get('mc_signal_reco') and f.Get('mc_background') and f.Get('data')) else 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1
    15	}
    16	merge_one () {
    17	  local BAND="$1" EP="$2"
    18	  local MERGED="${MERGEDIR}/runEventLoopOmniFold_5D_MEFHC_active_${BAND}_${EP}.root"
    19	  if [[ -s "${MERGED}" ]] && valid_merged "${MERGED}"; then echo "[merge] SKIP ${BAND}:${EP} valid ($(stat -c '%s' "${MERGED}")B)"; return 0; fi
    20	  [[ -s "${MERGED}" ]] && echo "[merge] REDO ${BAND}:${EP} (existing invalid/partial)" && rm -f "${MERGED}"
    21	  local INPUTS=(); for PL in "${PLAYLISTS[@]}"; do local f="${ND}/active_universe_5d/standard/${BAND}_${EP}/runEventLoopOmniFold_5D_${PL}_active_${BAND}_${EP}.root"; [[ -s "$f" ]] && INPUTS+=("$f"); done
    22	  [[ ${#INPUTS[@]} -ne 12 ]] && { echo "[merge] ABORT ${BAND}:${EP} ${#INPUTS[@]}/12"; return 3; }
    23	  python "${REPO}/2d-unfolding/uq/hadd_universes_full.py" "${MERGED}" "${INPUTS[@]}" > "${MERGEDIR}/merge_${BAND}_${EP}.log" 2>&1 \
    24	    && echo "[merge] DONE ${BAND}:${EP} ($(stat -c '%s' "${MERGED}")B)" || { echo "[merge] FAIL ${BAND}:${EP}"; rm -f "${MERGED}"; return 4; }
    25	}
    26	# J31 (AUDIT-FINDINGS-20260731): merge failures used to be converted into success, twice over.
    27	# `merge_one`'s last command on the failure path was `rm -f`, which returns 0 whether or not the
    28	# file exists, so the function exited 0; and a bare `wait` discards every child status anyway,
    29	# including the `return 3` abort the author did write. NMERGED was computed, printed, and never
    30	# compared to EXPECTED, and there is no `set -e`. Fixing only the `rm` would have changed nothing.
    31	# So: collect the PIDs, wait on each one individually, and fail closed on the count.
    32	EXPECTED=$(( ${#BANDS[@]} * 2 ))
    33	PIDS=(); LABELS=()
    34	for BAND in "${BANDS[@]}"; do for EP in 0 1; do
    35	  while [ "$(jobs -rp | wc -l)" -ge "$CONC" ]; do sleep 5; done
    36	  merge_one "$BAND" "$EP" &
    37	  PIDS+=($!); LABELS+=("${BAND}:${EP}")
    38	done; done
    39	NFAILED=0
    40	for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
    41	  if ! wait "${PIDS[$i]}"; then
    42	    echo "[merge] child ${LABELS[$i]} exited non-zero (rc=$?)" >&2
    43	    NFAILED=$(( NFAILED + 1 ))
    44	  fi
    45	done
    46	NMERGED=$(find "${MERGEDIR}" -name 'runEventLoopOmniFold_5D_MEFHC_active_*.root' -size +0c 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    47	echo "[p4-merge] merges done $(date -u +%T); merged=${NMERGED}/${EXPECTED}; failed_children=${NFAILED}"
    48	if [[ "${NFAILED}" -ne 0 || "${NMERGED}" -ne "${EXPECTED}" ]]; then
    49	  echo "[p4-merge][FAIL] ${NMERGED}/${EXPECTED} merged, ${NFAILED} child failure(s) -- refusing to" >&2
    50	  echo "  run the acceptance audit on an incomplete merge set. Re-run; merge_one is idempotent" >&2
    51	  echo "  (it SKIPs a valid merged file and REDOes an invalid one)." >&2
    52	  exit 5
    53	fi
    54	echo "[p4-audit] running acceptance audit..."
    55	cd "${ND}" && python3 p3s_manifest_summary.py --mode standard
    56	echo "[p4-merge-audit] complete $(date -u +%T)"
     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""P4 standard PURE-COMPONENT lateral replacement — FAIL-CLOSED (repair 2026-07-18).
     3	
     4	Builds a CANDIDATE 5D scalar covariance where ONLY the 5 support-limited kinematic
     5	lateral component blocks are swapped for the selection-complete active per-band
     6	blocks; all non-lateral components (vertical/stat/ML) are inherited unchanged:
     7	
     8	    C_new_total = C_old_total - sum(support_5) + sum(active_5)
     9	
    10	Gates (fail-closed, via p4_lib): exact 5 bands on BOTH sides; identical shape/mask;
    11	positive-finite active traces; exact component sum on the active side; symmetric+PSD
    12	result; optional 5D->4D projection non-mutation. Refuses to write onto any adopted/
    13	canonical path (candidate-only). Does NOT adopt. Authorized to RUN only after the
    14	standard-p4-verifier returns PASS.
    15	"""
    16	import argparse, sys
    17	import numpy as np
    18	import ROOT
    19	import p4_lib as P
    20	
    21	_FORBIDDEN = ("universe_stage2_5d/uq_universe_5d_covariance_combined",  # adopted names
    22	              "_uthrow", "adopted", "_final")
    23	
    24	
    25	def _load_bands_and_total(path, total_key="hCov_universe5d_total"):
    26	    f = ROOT.TFile.Open(path)
    27	    if not f or f.IsZombie():
    28	        raise P.P4GateError(f"cannot open {path}")
    29	    def rd(key):
    30	        h = f.Get(key)
    31	        if not h:
    32	            return None
    33	        n = h.GetNbinsX(); C = np.empty((n, n))
    34	        for i in range(n):
    35	            for j in range(n):
    36	                C[i, j] = h.GetBinContent(i + 1, j + 1)
    37	        return C
    38	    bands = {b: rd(f"hCov_universe5d_{b}") for b in P.BANDS}
    39	    bands = {b: c for b, c in bands.items() if c is not None}
    40	    total = rd(total_key)
    41	    f.Close()
    42	    return bands, total
    43	
    44	
    45	def main():
    46	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    47	    ap.add_argument("--old-combined", required=True, help="old combined cov (support-limited per-band + total)")
    48	    ap.add_argument("--active-bands", required=True, help="active per-band cov ROOT")
    49	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="CANDIDATE output (never an adopted path)")
    50	    a = ap.parse_args()
    51	
    52	    for bad in _FORBIDDEN:
    53	        P.require(bad not in a.out, f"refusing to write candidate onto adopted/canonical path ({bad})")
    54	
    55	    support, old_total = _load_bands_and_total(a.old_combined)
    56	    active, _ = _load_bands_and_total(a.active_bands)
    57	    P.require(old_total is not None, "old combined total missing")
    58	    P.require_exact_bands(support)
    59	    P.require_exact_bands(active)
    60	    P.component_traces_positive_finite(active)
    61	    for b in P.BANDS:
    62	        P.require(active[b].shape == support[b].shape == old_total.shape,
    63	                  f"shape/mask mismatch for band {b}")
    64	    # exact component sum on the active side (self-consistency of the replacement block)
    65	    active_sum = sum(active[b] for b in P.BANDS)
    66	    support_sum = sum(support[b] for b in P.BANDS)
    67	    new_total = old_total - support_sum + active_sum
    68	    stats = P.check_symmetric_psd(new_total)
    69	
    70	    fo = ROOT.TFile.Open(a.out, "RECREATE")
    71	    n = new_total.shape[0]
    72	    h = ROOT.TH2D("hCov_lateralrepl5d_total", "std pure-component lateral-replaced (CANDIDATE)",
    73	                  n, 0, n, n, 0, n)
    74	    for i in range(n):
    75	        for j in range(n):
    76	            h.SetBinContent(i + 1, j + 1, new_total[i, j])
    77	    h.Write()
    78	    for b in P.BANDS:
    79	        hb = ROOT.TH2D(f"hCov_lateralrepl5d_active_{b}", b, n, 0, n, n, 0, n)
    80	        for i in range(n):
    81	            for j in range(n):
    82	                hb.SetBinContent(i + 1, j + 1, active[b][i, j])
    83	        hb.Write()
    84	    fo.Close()
    85	    print(f"CANDIDATE written {a.out}: sqrt_tr={np.sqrt(max(0,np.trace(new_total))):.4e} "
    86	          f"min/max_eig={stats['min_eig']/max(1e-300,abs(stats['max_eig'])):.2e} (PASS gates)")
    87	    sys.exit(0)
    88	
    89	
    90	if __name__ == "__main__":
    91	    try:
    92	        main()
    93	    except P.P4GateError as e:
    94	        print(f"FAIL-CLOSED :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)

docs/orchestration/FINDINGS.md:67:| BEN-041 | **A provenance chain with no FIELD for a property cannot be read as asserting that property is fine — and the sibling lane's gate had trained me to expect one.** Asked whether the ten standard 5D lateral endpoint unfolds were publication-grade, I first reported "no `bkg-mode` stamp found in the logs" — treating absence as *unknown*. Both halves of that were wrong in opposite directions. **(1) The absence was positive evidence, not missing evidence.** `unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.py` announces its mode on the negweight branches (`:842`, `:895`) and the purity branch (`:883`) is **silent**, emitting only `build_measured_training_nd`'s `[INFO] measured training: …`. So a log with no `bkg-mode=` line and that signature line *identifies the purity path*, exactly the asymmetry `fps_build_control_manifest.py` already encodes (launcher omits the flag + source default is purity + no negweight announcement in the log). I had read that file minutes earlier and still did not apply its logic. **Rule: before calling evidence missing, check whether the code path you are testing for is the silent one — in a two-branch print, silence is a branch.** **(2) The stamp I was looking for does not exist anywhere in that lane.** `p4_evidence.py` has no `bkg`/`footing`/`mode` handling at all; the standard manifest binds hashes only. I had generalized from `fps_provenance.require_footing` (which fails closed on a missing `bkg_mode`) to an expectation that *any* P4 manifest carries footing. **Rule: a fail-closed gate in one lane is not evidence the sibling lane has one; grep the consumer for the field before concluding a value is wrong, missing, or unchecked — "no field" and "field says purity" demand different fixes.** **(3) The scope-sizing lesson, and the reason this is not just a bookkeeping note.** Having found purity footing, the tempting conclusion was "wrong footing, must re-run". +def require_recompute_hashes(manifest, repo_root="."):

+    equal the manifest's stored lowercase-64-hex hash. Never trusts a plausible string: catches a

+def mask_fingerprint(mask_bool):
+    """CANONICAL reported-mask fingerprint: sha256 of the 285-length boolean mask as uint8 bytes
+    (C-order). Construction locked by fps_reported_mask.py against the verifier target
+    REPORTED_MASK_FINGERPRINT (23b2a2f4...). Builders RECOMPUTE this from CV>0 and compare -- they
+    never trust the manifest string alone."""
+    m = np.asarray(mask_bool, dtype=bool)
+    if m.ndim != 1:

+    return sha256_bytes(m.astype(np.uint8).tobytes())

+def require_reported_mask(mask_bool):

+    canonical value; also require exactly N_REPORTED (266) true bins on the 285-bin grid."""

+def _reject_deferred(manifest):

+def require_pass_receipt(receipt, manifest_digest):
+    """The MANIFEST PASS receipt (from the publication-manifest builder): schema-versioned, result=PASS,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed provenance + gate library for the FPS selection-complete lateral covariance
chain (Agent C, P4-FPS / P6-FPS-final). ROOT-FREE by design: pure python + hashlib + numpy so
every gate is unit-testable without a compute node, and the ROOT-facing scripts (rollup /
validator / adopt / unified-adopt) call these same functions after loading matrices via ROOT.

Motivation (2026-07-18 reconciliation): the ten existing FPS endpoint unfolds were produced with
the unfold default --bkg-mode=purity (both launchers omit --bkg-mode), so they are PURITY CONTROLS,
not publication inputs. The selected publication footing is 'negweight-refined'. These gates make
that distinction structural: a purity/default/missing background mode CANNOT enter a publication
rollup, and every covariance step fails closed on inventory / order / mask / footing / identity.

Every `require_*` raises FpsGateError (fail-closed) with an explicit message; never returns a soft
pass. `check_*` / compute helpers return values for callers to gate on.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os

import numpy as np

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- canonical layout
# FPS extended grid (from both FPS unfold launchers; C-order ravel of (pt, pz)).
PT_EDGES = [0.0, 0.07, 0.15, 0.25, 0.33, 0.40, 0.47, 0.55, 0.70, 0.85,
            1.00, 1.25, 1.50, 2.50, 4.50, 30.0]                       # 16 edges -> 15 pt bins
PZ_EDGES = [0.0, 0.75, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0,
            6.0, 7.0, 8.0, 9.0, 10.0, 15.0, 20.0, 40.0, 60.0, 120.0]  # 20 edges -> 19 pz bins
NPT = len(PT_EDGES) - 1          # 15
NPZ = len(PZ_EDGES) - 1          # 19
NBINS_EXT = NPT * NPZ            # 285 (extended grid, C-order)
RAVEL_ORDER = "C"

# the 5 selection-complete lateral bands x the 2 endpoints
BANDS = ["BeamAngleX", "BeamAngleY", "MuonResolution",
         "Muon_Energy_MINERvA", "Muon_Energy_MINOS"]
ENDPOINTS = (0, 1)
N_ENDPOINTS = len(BANDS) * len(ENDPOINTS)   # 10

PUBLICATION_BKG_MODE = "negweight-refined"
CONTROL_BKG_MODE = "purity"

    "seed": 42,

    "use_weights": True,
    "full_phase_space": True,
}
FOOTING_KEYS = list(REQUIRED_FOOTING) + ["bkg_mode"]


class FpsGateError(Exception):
    """Raised by any fail-closed gate. Message names the exact artifact + failure."""


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- hashing helpers
def sha256_file(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise FpsGateError(f"sha256_file: missing artifact {path}")
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def sha256_bytes(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def sha256_partial(path, edge_bytes=8 << 20):
    """Bounded content fingerprint (size + head + tail) for very large files where a full-file
    SHA256 is impractical (the 74GB merged endpoint inputs = 740GB of login-node I/O for all ten).
    NOT a full hash: labeled 'partial-headtail' so a caller can never mistake it for one; the full
    input identity is corroborated by the merged-endpoint audit receipt. A full SHA256 remains a
    recorded residual evidence gap until it can be computed on a compute node."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise FpsGateError(f"sha256_partial: missing artifact {path}")
    sz = os.path.getsize(path)
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(f"size={sz};".encode())
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        h.update(f.read(min(edge_bytes, sz)))
        if sz > edge_bytes:
            f.seek(max(0, sz - edge_bytes))
            h.update(f.read(edge_bytes))
    return f"partial-headtail{edge_bytes}b:{h.hexdigest()}"

class FpsGateError(Exception):
    """Raised by any fail-closed gate. Message names the exact artifact + failure."""


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- hashing helpers
def sha256_file(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise FpsGateError(f"sha256_file: missing artifact {path}")
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def sha256_bytes(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def sha256_partial(path, edge_bytes=8 << 20):
    """Bounded content fingerprint (size + head + tail) for very large files where a full-file
    SHA256 is impractical (the 74GB merged endpoint inputs = 740GB of login-node I/O for all ten).
    NOT a full hash: labeled 'partial-headtail' so a caller can never mistake it for one; the full
    input identity is corroborated by the merged-endpoint audit receipt. A full SHA256 remains a
    recorded residual evidence gap until it can be computed on a compute node."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise FpsGateError(f"sha256_partial: missing artifact {path}")
    sz = os.path.getsize(path)
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(f"size={sz};".encode())
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        h.update(f.read(min(edge_bytes, sz)))
        if sz > edge_bytes:
            f.seek(max(0, sz - edge_bytes))
            h.update(f.read(edge_bytes))
    return f"partial-headtail{edge_bytes}b:{h.hexdigest()}"

    def _get_default_tempdir():
        """Calculate the default directory to use for temporary files.
        This routine should be called exactly once.
    
        We determine whether or not a candidate temp dir is usable by
        trying to create and write to a file in that directory.  If this
        is successful, the test file is deleted.  To prevent denial of
        service, the name of the test file must be randomized."""
    
        namer = _RandomNameSequence()
        dirlist = _candidate_tempdir_list()
    
        for dir in dirlist:
            if dir != _os.curdir:
                dir = _os.path.abspath(dir)
            # Try only a few names per directory.
            for seq in range(100):
                name = next(namer)
                filename = _os.path.join(dir, name)
                try:
                    fd = _os.open(filename, _bin_openflags, 0o600)
                    try:
                        try:
                            _os.write(fd, b'blat')
                        finally:
                            _os.close(fd)
                    finally:
                        _os.unlink(filename)
                    return dir
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
                except PermissionError:
                    # This exception is thrown when a directory with the chosen name
                    # already exists on windows.
                    if (_os.name == 'nt' and _os.path.isdir(dir) and
                        _os.access(dir, _os.W_OK)):
                        continue
                    break   # no point trying more names in this directory
                except OSError:
                    break   # no point trying more names in this directory

   115	        for _k in ("active_only_eq_sum5_relerr", "C_combined_eq_syst_stat_ml_relerr",
   116	                   "full_total_residual_eq_stat_plus_ml_relerr"):
   117	            P.require(_k in ids, f"component manifest missing measured identity {_k}")
   118	            P.require(float(ids[_k]) <= float(ids.get("identity_rtol", 1e-9)),
   119	                      f"component manifest records a FAILING identity {_k}={ids[_k]}")
   120	        P.require(comp.get("reported_mask_hash") == man.get("mask5d_hash"),
   121	                  "component manifest reported-mask hash != evidence manifest")
   122	        for k in comp.get("candidate_keys", []):
   123	            P.require(_th2(a.candidate, k) is not None,
   124	                      f"component manifest claims key {k} which the candidate does not contain")
   125	        out["component_manifest"] = comp_path
   126	        out["component_manifest_sha256"] = P.sha256_file(comp_path)
   127	        out["gates"].append("component_manifest_bound")
   128	
   129	        active = {b: _th2(a.candidate, f"hCov_active5d_{b}") for b in P.BANDS}
   130	        active = {b: c for b, c in active.items() if c is not None}
   131	        P.require_exact_bands(active); out["gates"].append("exact_5_active_bands")
   132	        out["active_traces"] = P.component_traces_positive_finite(active); out["gates"].append("traces_pos_finite")
   133	        active_total = _th2(a.candidate, "hCov_active5d_total")
   134	        P.require(active_total is not None, "candidate active-only total missing")
   135	        out["active_only_sum_relerr"] = P.check_component_sum(active_total, active)
   136	        out["gates"].append("active_total_eq_sum5")
   137	        for key in (P.CANDIDATE_ACTIVE_TOTAL_KEY, P.CANDIDATE_SYST_KEY, P.CANDIDATE_TOTAL_KEY):
   138	            P.check_symmetric_psd(_th2(a.candidate, key))
   139	        out["gates"].append("symmetric_psd")
   140	        # D4b/D6 REPAIR-5: repair-4 checked only that (C_combined - C_syst) was symmetric PSD
   141	        # and named that the full-total identity, in the gate name, the receipt field and the
   142	        # test. PSD is necessary and nowhere near sufficient -- every covariance-shaped residual
   143	        # passes it. The identity is now PROVEN by loading the stat and ML blocks the component
   144	        # manifest binds (with their recorded sha256 re-verified, so the comparison cannot be
   145	        # satisfied by substituting different blocks) and comparing.
   146	        Csyst = _th2(a.candidate, P.CANDIDATE_SYST_KEY)
   147	        Ccomb = _th2(a.candidate, P.CANDIDATE_TOTAL_KEY)
   148	        stat_spec, ml_spec = comp.get("stat_cov"), comp.get("ml_cov")
   149	        P.require(stat_spec and ml_spec, "component manifest does not bind the stat/ML blocks")
   150	
   151	        def _bound_block(spec, sha_key, label):
   152	            """Load a `path:key` block AFTER re-verifying the sha256 the manifest recorded, so
   153	            the identity cannot be satisfied by substituting a different file."""
   154	            P.require(":" in spec, f"{label} spec {spec!r} is not path:key")
   155	            pth, key = spec.rsplit(":", 1)
   156	            ap = pth if os.path.isabs(pth) else os.path.join(P.ND_ROOT, pth)
   157	            P.require(os.path.exists(ap), f"{label} covariance not found: {pth}")
   158	            P.require(P.sha256_file(ap) == comp.get(sha_key),
   159	                      f"{label} covariance sha256 drift vs the component manifest ({pth})")
   160	            blk = _th2(ap, key)
   161	            P.require(blk is not None, f"{label} covariance key {key} missing in {pth}")
   162	            return blk
   163	
   164	        C_stat = _bound_block(stat_spec, "stat_sha256", "stat")
   165	        C_ml = _bound_block(ml_spec, "ml_sha256", "ML")
   166	        out["full_total_identity_relerr"] = float(
   167	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb, Csyst, C_stat, C_ml, 1e-9))
   168	        out["gates"].append("full_total_identity_recomputed")
   169	        support_bands = {b: _th2(a.support, f"hCov_universe5d_{b}") for b in P.BANDS}
   170	        P.require(all(support_bands[b] is not None for b in P.BANDS), "support family lateral block incomplete")
   171	        out["support_comparison"] = P.check_support_comparison(active_total, sum(support_bands[b] for b in P.BANDS))
   172	        out["gates"].append("complete_support_comparison")
   173	        out["result"] = "PASS"
   174	    except P.P4GateError as e:
   175	        out["error"] = str(e); json.dump(out, open(a.out, "w"), indent=2)
   176	        print(f"RESULT FAIL :: {e}"); sys.exit(1)
   177	    json.dump(out, open(a.out, "w"), indent=2)
   178	    print("RESULT PASS — gates:", ",".join(out["gates"]),
   400	    check_symmetric_psd(resid)
   401	    return prove_identity(resid, expect, rtol, "C_combined - C_syst == C_stat + C_ML")

   404	def check_declared_migration_policy(policy, census_abs, band, nonzero_bands, zero_bands):
   405	    """Compare the DECLARED migration policy against the OBSERVED census.
   406	
   407	    REPAIR-5 (pattern sweep). `check_merged_metadata` required `migration_policy` to be
   408	    truthy and compared it to nothing -- a declared policy no consumer ever checked, which is
   409	    the same presence-not-comparison pattern as defect 2's `code_rev`. A merged file could
   410	    declare any policy string, or the wrong one, and pass."""
   411	    require(isinstance(policy, str) and policy.strip(), "declared migration policy missing")
   412	    require(band in nonzero_bands or band in zero_bands,
   413	            f"band {band} is in neither the nonzero- nor the zero-migration set")
   414	    n = int(census_abs)
   415	    if band in nonzero_bands:
   416	        require(n > 0, f"{band} declares selection-complete migration but census is {n}")
   417	        require("selection" in policy.lower(),
   418	                f"{band} migrates ({n}) but declares policy {policy!r}, which does not claim "
   419	                f"selection completeness")
   420	    else:
   421	        require(n == 0, f"{band} is declared bin-migration-only but census is {n}")
   422	    return True
   488	def check_merged_metadata(meta):
   489	    """Merged-endpoint audit on extracted metadata (ROOT-free, so testable).
   490	    meta keys: tree_entries{mc_truth_denom,mc_signal_reco,mc_background,data},
   491	    mcPOT, dataPOT, hasTruthOnlyMisses, nTruthOnlyMisses,
   492	    census{TruthEntrants,TruthExits,RecoEntrants,RecoExits}, migration_policy."""
   493	    te = meta.get("tree_entries", {})
   494	    for t in ("mc_truth_denom", "mc_signal_reco", "mc_background", "data"):
   495	        require(te.get(t, 0) and te[t] > 0, f"merged tree {t} empty/absent")
   496	    mc, da = meta.get("mcPOT"), meta.get("dataPOT")
   497	    require(mc is not None and np.isfinite(mc) and mc > 0, "merged mcPOT not finite-positive")
   498	    require(da is not None and np.isfinite(da) and da > 0, "merged dataPOT not finite-positive")
   499	    require(te["mc_signal_reco"] == te["mc_truth_denom"],
   500	            f"signal_reco {te['mc_signal_reco']} != truth_denom {te['mc_truth_denom']} (completeness broken)")
   501	    require(meta.get("hasTruthOnlyMisses") is not None and meta.get("nTruthOnlyMisses") is not None,
   502	            "native-miss metadata missing")
   503	    cen = meta.get("census", {})
   504	    for k in ("TruthEntrants", "TruthExits", "RecoEntrants", "RecoExits"):
   505	        require(k in cen and cen[k] is not None, f"census counter {k} missing")
   506	    # repair-5 (pattern sweep): this used to be `require(meta.get("migration_policy"))` and
   507	    # nothing else -- a declared policy that no consumer ever compared to the observed census,
   508	    # so a merged file could declare any string, or the wrong one, and pass. When the caller
   509	    # supplies the band and census, the declaration is now CHECKED against them.
   510	    band = meta.get("band")
   511	    census_abs = meta.get("selection_migration_abs")
   512	    if band is not None and census_abs is not None:
   513	        check_declared_migration_policy(meta.get("migration_policy"), census_abs, band,
   514	                                        NONZERO_MIGRATION_BANDS, ZERO_MIGRATION_BANDS)
   515	    else:
   516	        require(isinstance(meta.get("migration_policy"), str) and meta["migration_policy"].strip(),
   517	                "declared migration policy missing")
   518	    return True
   568	    require(err <= rtol, f"component sum mismatch (rel {err:.2e}) — total != sum of bands")
   569	    return float(err)

   572	def check_support_comparison(active_cov, support_cov):
   573	    """Complete support comparison: both present, same shape/mask/order. Returns
   574	    sqrt-trace ratio (active/support). Fail-closed if the support block is absent."""
   575	    require(active_cov is not None, "active lateral block missing")
   576	    require(support_cov is not None, "support-limited comparison block missing")
   577	    A = np.asarray(active_cov, dtype=float); S = np.asarray(support_cov, dtype=float)
   578	    require(A.shape == S.shape, f"active/support shape mismatch {A.shape} vs {S.shape}")
   579	    sta = float(np.sqrt(max(0.0, np.trace(A)))); sts = float(np.sqrt(max(0.0, np.trace(S))))
   580	    require(sts > 0, "support block has zero trace")
   581	    return {"sqrt_tr_active": sta, "sqrt_tr_support": sts, "ratio": sta / sts}

   709	class Repair5SelfGuards(unittest.TestCase):
   710	    """REPAIR-5. One assertion per defect that FAILS if the defect is reintroduced.
   711	
   712	    Every check here is a live computation, not a source-text grep, except where the thing
   713	    being guarded IS a source property. If any of these can be deleted and the four defects
   714	    still stay fixed, the defect was not really closed."""
   715	
   716	    ND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
   717	
   718	    # ---------- D3: dirty-source guard must fail closed on a DELETED source ----------
   719	    def test_deleted_bound_source_is_a_blocker_not_a_pass(self):
   720	        """The old guard read `_w is None or _c == _w`; _worktree_blob returns None when the
   721	        file is gone, so DELETING a bound source passed the dirty check."""
   722	        src = (self.ND / "p4_evidence.py").read_text()
   723	        code = "\n".join(l for l in src.splitlines() if not l.lstrip().startswith("#"))
   724	        self.assertNotIn("_w is None or _c == _w", code)   # the fail-OPEN disjunct is gone
   725	        self.assertIn("need(_c == _w,", code)              # replaced by a direct comparison
   726	        self.assertIn("ABSENT from the working tree", code)
   727	        self.assertIn("os.path.exists(_abs)", code)
   728	        self.assertIn("`git hash-object` failed", code)   # git-unavailable distinguished
   729	
   730	    # ---------- D4a: containment must survive a symlink escape ----------
   731	    def test_symlink_escape_is_rejected(self):
   732	        """A symlink inside the candidate dir pointing out of it must not launder a path.
   733	        normpath could not see this; realpath can."""
   734	        import tempfile, os
   735	        cand_root = os.path.join(P.ND_ROOT, P.CANDIDATE_SUBDIR)
   736	        os.makedirs(cand_root, exist_ok=True)
   737	        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as outside:
   738	            link = os.path.join(cand_root, "_p5_escape_probe")
   739	            if os.path.islink(link) or os.path.exists(link):
   740	                os.remove(link)
   741	            os.symlink(outside, link)
   742	            try:
   743	                with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):
   744	                    P.require_candidate_path(os.path.join(link, "out.root"))
   745	            finally:
   746	                os.remove(link)
   747	
   748	    def test_absolute_path_outside_the_repo_is_rejected(self):
   749	        """The verifier's exact bypass: the component sequence appearing anywhere."""
   750	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):
   751	            P.require_candidate_path("/evil/active_universe_5d/standard/candidate/out.root")

   761	    # ---------- D4b: PSD is not the identity ----------
   762	    def test_psd_residual_that_is_not_stat_plus_ml_fails(self):
   763	        """THE self-guard for the overclaim. This residual is symmetric PSD -- so it passes the
   764	        repair-4 check -- but it is NOT stat+ML, so the real identity must reject it."""
   765	        Csyst = np.diag([4.0, 9.0])
   766	        Cstat = np.diag([1.0, 1.0])
   767	        Cml = np.diag([0.5, 0.5])
   768	        Ccomb_good = Csyst + Cstat + Cml
   769	        self.assertLessEqual(
   770	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb_good, Csyst, Cstat, Cml, 1e-9), 1e-9)
   771	        # residual = diag(3,3): symmetric, PSD, and wrong
   772	        Ccomb_bad = Csyst + np.diag([3.0, 3.0])
   773	        P.check_symmetric_psd(Ccomb_bad - Csyst)          # the weak check still passes...
   774	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):              # ...the real identity does not
   775	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb_bad, Csyst, Cstat, Cml, 1e-9)

   777	    def test_full_total_identity_catches_a_swapped_stat_block(self):
   778	        Csyst = np.diag([4.0, 9.0]); Cstat = np.diag([1.0, 2.0]); Cml = np.diag([0.5, 0.5])
   779	        Ccomb = Csyst + Cstat + Cml
   780	        with self.assertRaises(P4GateError):
   781	            P.check_full_total_identity(Ccomb, Csyst, np.diag([2.0, 1.0]), Cml, 1e-9)
